name: Minimap
author: jgarza
description: Workspace number, a separator, then a row of rectangles showing the active workspace's windows as a proportional scrolling-layout tape. Focused window is accent-filled, scrolled-off windows are dimmed. Click a rectangle to focus it, scroll to change workspace, right-click for number styles (numbers, roman, japanese, dots).

barWidget.description: Workspace number plus a mini tape of its windows.

schema.label: Workspace label
schema.description: How the workspace number is written.

options.label: Japanese
options.description: 一 二 三 四 五

schema.label: Maximum tape width
schema.description: Longest the row may get, in logical pixels. Beyond it the row scrolls with the focused window and a glowing edge shows where more windows are hidden.

schema.label: Show floating windows
schema.description: Include floating windows in the tape.

schema.label: Tabbed windows
schema.description: How a Hyprland group (tabbed windows) is drawn.

options.label: Tab bar
options.description: A row of tabs along the top of the box.

options.label: Letter "t"
options.description: A t in the middle of the box.

schema.label: Animation style
schema.description: Motion and effects for focus changes, windows opening and closing, and alerts.

options.label: Cyberpunk
options.description: Glitches, RGB split and hard flickers

options.label: Fun
options.description: Big bouncy pops, wobble and shockwaves

schema.label: Attention cues
schema.description: Highlight windows that are urgent or have a notification: minor (amber) and critical (red).

schema.label: State markers
schema.description: Marks inside a box for fullscreen, pinned and floating windows.

schema.label: Box actions
schema.description: Right-click a box for a window menu (focus, float, fullscreen, pin, move to workspace, close); middle-click closes the window.

schema.label: Drag to reorder
schema.description: Hold the right mouse button on a box and drag sideways to move its column (the bar keeps left-drag for moving widgets).
